up: List distinct molecules that have structural data and are reported in document CHEMBL3833083. Return the molecule name (pref_name), ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), and canonical SMILES. Join the document table via the compound_records table using the doc_id to ensure the molecules are from the specified document. Filter strictly by doc_id corresponding to CHEMBL3833083.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3833083'
